body: `Call` is a method the program itself declared; a `Core` member goes to `CoreCall`, which codegen hands to `emit_helper` under `rule:errors/propagation`'s fixed signature (`crates/nvs-codegen/src/emit.rs:585`), so a change to what a `Core` call site carries written against `Call` reaches nothing. Read the `emit` arm for the variant first, and copy `InstKind::ShapeCodecConst` when what you add is a compile-time constant the member reads off its own `args`.
